summary.text: Adam Scanlon is a Democratic state representative from the 14th Bristol District who has held the seat since January 6, 2021 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Adam Scanlon was born in Attleboro, Massachusetts, and earned a bachelor's degree from Framingham State University in 2019.
His career experience includes working for a nonprofit in Boston.
He succeeded Republican Elizabeth Poirier in the 14th Bristol District seat in 2021.

In the 2025-2026 session he is vice chair of the House Post Audit and Oversight Committee and also serves on the House Committee on Federal Funding, Policy and Accountability and the Economic Development and Emerging Technologies and Emergency Preparedness and Management joint committees.
